author: Forbes
description:
Forbes assistant managing editor Katherine Schwab sits down with Carina Hong, the 24-year-old CEO and co-founder of Axiom Math, to discuss her ambitious mission to build the world's first "AI mathematician". 

Discover how her revolutionary new AI system recently achieved a perfect score on the hardest college math test in the US and is already producing original, peer-reviewed scientific research. We explore what happens when artificial intelligence moves beyond everyday chatbots to tackle complex theoretical reasoning, how this capability could fundamentally change the future of software development, and what it all means for the future of human intelligence. 

Tune in to find out why the next massive leap in tech might just be rooted in formal mathematics.

0:00 The Vision For An AI Mathematician
04:14 Real-World Applications And The Self-Improving AI Loop 
06:00 Axiom Prover And The Push For Code Verification 
14:58 From Math Olympiads To AI Innovation 
16:39 Neolabs And The Futur
title: The AI That Aced The Hardest Math Test: Inside Axiom Math
